description: List the BankConv account's recent conversions, newest first, one line each: conversion id, status, file name, page count and upload time. Use it to find the id of an earlier conversion for get_transactions or download_statement, or to check on one still processing. Read-only.

limit.description: How many conversions to list, 1 to 100.

status.description: Only list conversions with this status. no_credits means it waits for pages; failed means the PDF couldn't be converted.

name: list_conversions
title: List recent conversions
